descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-06 Measuring How the Pilot Is Working (Usage Analytics) · S07 Send a handoff in both contexts: generated and sent rows on the sender only, the follow-up prompt right after, its answer stored (Skip stores nothing), Copy recorded

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U4 Sending a handoff logs both the handoff generation and the send (UAT OAT-06 Test 4; TFA-94514 AC 3)
  • U5 Immediately after a handoff is sent, an in-app prompt appears asking 'Did having this make you more likely to send a handoff today?' (Yes / No / Not sure), and the answer is stored (UAT OAT-06 Test 4; TFA-94514 AC 3; TFA-94609 Spec 2; TFA-94609 AC 5)
  • U7 Per physician per day: notes generated, handoffs sent, and time from Pre-Round opened to note complete are aggregated and queryable in Convex (UAT OAT-06 Test 6; TFA-94514 AC 6)
  • U13 Every AI call (pre-round summary, note generation, billing, Ask AI, photo capture, handoff) logs its total time and, separately, the time the AI provider itself took, and which model answered (UAT 3.5; UAT 3.9; TFA-94514 AC 7)
  • U15 Usage analytics rows carry no patient content (no name, MRN, room, diagnosis, task text or note text), so rows that outlive a deleted patient do not break the 36 h retention claim or TC-24's hard del … (UAT 3.6; UAT TC-24)

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Fresh physician with one Hospital patient and one Nursing Home resident, plus a second @roundai.test colleague account in the recipient list with its own signed-in session; T0 and both accounts' rollups read at T0

When Hospital: open the handoff screen, wait for Send, send to the colleague, answer 'Not sure'; tap Copy Text. Nursing Home: the same send, then tap Skip. Then, signed in as the colleague, open the received handoff

Then Hospital: handoff_generated (hospital, patientCount >= 1) before the send, handoff_sent (hospital, handoffId, patientCount = sheet size); the question 'Did having this make you more likely to send a handoff today?' with Yes / No / Not sure appears right after the send; …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT OAT-06 Test 4 + TFA-94514 AC 3, per physician (Test 6). cp1/cp4 mustContain the dialog name 'Handoff follow-up question' and the full question; cp2/cp5 mustNotContain the question; cp6 (the colleague) mustNotContain it. Post-run read for the rows on both accounts, and diagnostics:list read right after each send (aiCallLog keeps 8 rows). Copy is recorded, not judged (Q20). …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S07 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-06.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: MULTI · Multi-device / multi-account — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: newspec-c.

UAT item: OAT-06 Measuring How the Pilot Is Working (Usage Analytics) · Section: B · Operational Acceptance Tests · Scenario: OAT-06/S07

Send a handoff in both contexts: generated and sent rows on the sender only, the follow-up prompt right after, its answer stored (Skip stores nothing), Copy recorded

Tickets: TFA-94514 Analytics tracking (ready for qa); TFA-94609 Pilot Surveys (ready for qa)

New local lane newspec-c: status passed in newspec-c/results.json → passed (passed).

Detail:

Local QA stack only (round-companion-wt-qa at main 43c38a4f, the build dev runs); brand-new @roundai.test accounts; survey, usage and patient-activity rows read with the local admin key; no model call from these specs (the Convex socket answers generateHandoff in the browser and refuses every other ai/* action; tripwire: no Generate). Re-run on 43c38a4f: the handoff screens did not change between e02167f and 43c38a4f (git diff over src/components/HandoffOverlay.tsx, src/features/handoff/*, convex/handoffs.ts and convex/ai/assist.ts is empty); surveys.submit did (a fourth survey kind). A brand-new sender and a brand-new colleague ('Dr. QA Colleague <tag>', its own signed-in context); one Hospital patient and one Nursing Home resident (In Today); generateHandoff answered at the socket. Judged 13/13. Hospital send 1: handoff_generated (hospital, patientCount 1) before handoff_sent (hospital, the sent handoff's id, patientCount 1 = the sheet); the 'Handoff follow-up question' dialog ('Sent — one quick question', 'Did having this make you more likely to send a handoff today?', Yes / No / Not sure, Skip) 110 ms after Send; 'Not sure' stores one handoff_followup row {moreLikelyToSendHandoff: not_sure} with that handoffId. Fires every time (TFA-94609 Spec 2): send 2 from the same sheet (its button now reads 'Sent to <colleague>' and opens the picker again) brings the question again and 'Yes' is stored with the second handoff's id; send 3 from the sheet opened again from the list brings it again and 'No' is stored with the third id. Nursing Home: handoff_generated before handoff_sent (nursing_home, its id, patientCount 1); the question 106 ms after Send; Skip closes it and stores no row (AC 4). Sender's rollup today: handoffsSent +3 hospital / +1 nursing_home, handoffsGenerated +2 / +1 (one per sheet visit). Colleague: the received handoff shows the patient and no question; no handoff_* usage row, no follow-up row, no rollup row. U15: none of the 10 rows holds a name, room or the handoff text. Recorded (Q20): Copy Text shows 'Copied', writes no row and brings no question. Not judged here: U13 (aiCallLog providerMs / model for generateHandoff) needs a live call, i.e. dev, where Send is refused (runner-contract §10.4).

Evidence: 9 attached.

Dev run: skipped: not runnable on dev — not-runnable-on-dev: seed-second-account, multi-session, permission-send-handoff, backend-read-admin. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
